newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK OF CYPRUS-GREECE SAYS H1 PROFIT UP 27.6PCT.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF CYPRUS-GREECE SAYS H1 PROFIT UP 27.6PCT.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus-Greece said on Thursday its first half profit rose 27.6 percent to 2.173 billion drachmas from 1.703 billion in the same period a year earlier.
It experienced a 24 percent growth in deposits which grew to 92.7 billion drachmas while loans rose 29 percent to 113.2 billion. Its total assets increased by 36 percent reaching 190.8 billion.
"The bank's international expertise and modern approach to banking have sealed its five-year dynamic presence in Greece," it said.

The Bank of Cyprus presently has a network of eight branches in Greece and plans to open three new branches in 1997. Its administrative headquarters will soon move to newly acquired premises at Leoforos Alexandras in Athens. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
